app.name: MathLens
app.subtitle: AI-Graded Handwritten Math Exams with Video Remediation

landing.loginTitle: Sign in to your Student Account
landing.loginDesc: Sign in with your email and password to access all your saved exams and enter new quiz codes.
landing.registerDesc: Create your account to save all your exams, grades, AI feedback, and remediation progress in one place.
landing.consentInline: I agree to the privacy notice and AI-assisted essay grading with teacher review.
landing.joinDesc: Enter the cohort code from your teacher and your display name.

teacher.loginSubtitle: Sign in to manage topics, twin exam models, review queues, and analytics.
teacher.readyBanner: Platform foundation ready for topic authoring and cohort analytics.

topics.title: Topics & Exams
topics.subtitle: Author topics with paired Pre-Test (Model 1), Post-Test (Model 2), remediation video, and rubrics.
topics.emptyState: No topics yet. Create your first topic or import a JSON exam bundle.

builder.placeholderBanner: Action needed before publishing: placeholders or confirmations remain ({{reasons}}).
builder.checklistReady: All publish checks pass! Ready to publish both exam models.

questionEditor.solutionUrlHint: YouTube video link (or external resource) explaining the solution for this specific question.

importModal.title: Import Exam Bundle JSON
importModal.subtitle: Upload or paste a JSON bundle, preview the dry-run diff, then apply.

cohorts.title: Cohorts
cohorts.subtitle: Create Treatment (video-gated) and Control cohorts and share join codes with students.
cohorts.showProvisional: Show provisional score while under review
cohorts.splitDesc: Paste student names (one per line) to randomly split them between Treatment and Control.
cohorts.emptyState: No cohorts yet. Create your first cohort for a topic.

student.resumeCardTitle: Save this code to return later
student.resumeCardSubtitle: Write it down or take a screenshot to resume your exam from any device.
student.consentPoint1: We collect only your display name (no email, no phone number, no tracking pixels).
student.consentPoint2: Essay answers are graded with AI against the teacher's rubric and reviewed by your teacher.
student.consentPoint3: Uploaded solution photos are automatically deleted after the retention period.
student.consentCheckbox: I understand and agree to proceed.

portal.enterQuizCodeDesc: Enter the 6-character code from your teacher to join a new quiz or open an enrolled quiz.
portal.savedQuizzesEmpty: You haven't joined any quizzes yet. Enter a quiz code above to begin and all your results will be saved here automatically.
portal.pretestGradingDesc: MCQ responses are scored; handwritten essays are being processed.
portal.comparisonReady: Both exams completed! Full comparison view unlocks here.

exam.oneMinWarning: Final minute remaining! Review your work before auto-submit.
exam.confirmSubmitWarning: You cannot modify answers or photos after submitting.
exam.offlineSaved: Offline: pending MCQ choices are saved locally and will sync automatically.
exam.photoGuideTips: Good lighting · Flat page · Full solution in frame · Dark pen
exam.dropzoneLabel: Drop photo here or tap to capture/select (max 2 images, 8 MB each)
exam.maxTwoPhotos: Maximum 2 photos uploaded for this question.

results.title: Exam Results & Feedback
results.scorePendingDesc: Your MCQ answers are scored immediately. Handwritten essays flagged for review are hidden until your teacher confirms the grade.
results.provisionalBanner: Provisional AI score (subject to final teacher review)
results.misreadNotePlaceholder: Optional: tell your teacher which step was misread...
results.misreadSent: Sent for teacher review — your teacher will check the photo directly.

review.title: Essay Review Queue
review.subtitle: Inspect flagged or student-reported handwritten solutions, compare to model answer & rubric, and confirm grades.
review.emptyQueue: No essay answers currently need review.
review.shortcutsHint: Shortcuts: J Next · K Previous · A Approve AI · E Edit Criteria

students.title: Students Roster
students.subtitle: Track individual progress across pre-test, remediation video watch time, and post-test.
students.searchPlaceholder: Search by student name or resume code...
students.emptyState: No students match the current filter.

remediation.title: Remediation Video
remediation.subtitle: Watch the explanation video for each question you missed at normal speed (<= 1.5x) to unlock Model 2.
remediation.remainingQuestionsLabel: {{count}} question video(s) remaining to unlock Model 2
remediation.unlockedBanner: All required question videos reviewed! Model 2 (Post-Test) is now unlocked.
remediation.wrongSegmentsTitle: Select a question to watch its explanation video:
remediation.playerErrorBanner: The YouTube player failed to load (Code {{code}}). Your teacher has been alerted and can manually unlock Model 2 if blocked on your network.
remediation.fraudWarning: Note: skipping ahead, hidden tabs, or speeds above 1.5x do not count toward watch time.

comparison.title: Before & After Performance Comparison
comparison.subtitle: Track your improvement between Model 1 (Pre-Test) and Model 2 (Post-Test).
comparison.controlEthicsDesc: Even though your group skipped the video before Model 2, the full solution walkthrough is now available for you.

analytics.title: Experiment Analytics & Formal Statistics
analytics.subtitle: Evaluate pre/post improvement, Treatment vs Control causal gain, concept mastery, and AI grading reliability.
analytics.statsUnavailable: Statistical computation service is currently offline; showing descriptive metrics only.

usage.title: AI Grading Cost & Telemetry
usage.subtitle: Track provider usage, daily USD cap, latency percentiles, and call reliability.
usage.emptyState: No AI grading calls recorded in this window.

pdfImport.stage_OCR_AND_AI_EXTRACTION: Running dual OCR transcription, Q/A pairing & SymPy checks...
pdfImport.previewSubtitle: Inspect extracted KaTeX questions, MCQ keys, essay solutions, and rubric weights alongside the original rendered PDF pages before saving.
pdfImport.appliedBanner: Imported successfully! Redirecting to Topic Builder...
